title: Homoleptic complexes of titanium(IV) fused with O^N^O Schiff base derivatives: design, BSA–DNA interaction, molecular docking, DFT and cytotoxicity
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,25075-25102
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03821A, Paper

Shivabasayya V. Salimath, Kavita B. Hiremath, Mahabarathi Subramaniyan, Arjita Ghosh, Evangeline Lawrence, Anbalagan Moorthy, Murugesh Shivashankar, Madhvesh Pathak
A set of six Ti(IV) complexes were examined for in vitro DNA and BSA binding investigations and their cytotoxic assays were steered to ascertain the antiproliferative capability of these Ti(IV) derivatives.
